text: Zegona completed the 100% acquisition of Vodafone Spain on 31 May 2024 and describes itself as the 100% owner of Vodafone Spain, the telecom operator; Vodafone Spain is the company behind the Lowi brand, whose legal page still carries Vodafone España (Avenida de América 115, Madrid) as the operator of the registered Lowi trademarks. Corroborating source: Zegona corporate site (acquisition completed banner) (https://zegona.com/): "On 31 May 2024, Zegona completed the 100% acquisition of Vodafone Spain."
short: Zegona Communications Plc owns 100% of Vodafone Spain, the operator behind Lowi.

source.name: Zegona, Investment in Vodafone Spain
source.quote: Zegona is the 100% owner of Vodafone Spain, a telecom operator providing mobile and fixed line services to both consumers and business customers in Spain.
